summary: Establish reusable DSL standards, documented vocabulary, and security findings gate

delivery.outcome: A reusable DSL kernel with deterministic command/error/security documentation and a publication-blocking normalized findings gate.
nonGoals: Migrate existing DSL repositories in ticket-001
Define all domain profiles in the initial kernel
Modify twin-probes or subactor/contracts in this ticket
Treat a documented critical issue as resolved or approved
Install CI or local hook files before the gate contract is merged
Publish or merge without independent current-head review

architecture.decision: Use one neutral manifest with derived case-sensitive help paths and normalized probe findings; domain DSLs own their vocabulary while a trusted gate, never a probe, decides publication.
dataChanges: Introduce wellmanifest.dsl/manifest/v1 as a new pre-stable contract
Add a strict documentation catalog and wellmanifest.dsl/findings/v1 definition to the pre-stable manifest schema
architecture.rollback: Remove the five ticket-owned implementation files; governance bootstrap and ticket evidence remain preserved.

commands: docker run --rm --network none dsl-governance python3 .governance/governance_check.py --root . --manifest .governance/manifest.json --lock .governance/manifest.lock.json --stack-profiles .governance/stack-profiles.json --actor agent --changed-file spec/DSL_STANDARD.md --changed-file schemas/dsl-manifest.schema.json --changed-file src/dsl_check.py --changed-file docs/ARCHITECTURE.md --changed-file docs/LOGIC_FLOW.md
